name: Alexander Nevsky Cathedral
_about: ALEXANDER NEVSKY CATHEDRAL, Sofia (A. N. Pomerantsev, 1882 / 1904-12), at its real size from OSM (way 155447771, 73.5 x 52.2 m) and photos: the cross-in-square under the gilded dome on its drum of twenty windows (45 m), the transept arms ending in green semidomes on half rings of windows, the apse's semidome behind the bema, the nave's barrel vault to the west; five aisles, the inner ones with galleries reached by dog-leg stairs, the outer ones single storey, the east corners round under low quarter-domes; the narthex with its corner chapels under small domes and arcaded porches; the frontispiece with its great arched gable over the three-arched porch, the bell tower on it (53 m) with its belfry and gilded dome. Inside: the central, Russian and Bulgarian iconostases, the solea, the thrones under their canopies, the altar's baldachin, the great chandelier under the dome; painted walls, mosaic vaults, the chequered marble floor.

piers._about: the four great piers at the corners of the 17 m square, painted with saints

pier heads._about: the piers carried up between the arches' haunches to the deck

great arches._about: the four great arches from pier to pier

pendentives._about: the pendentives turning the square into the drum's circle

drum deck._about: the square deck over the arches and pendentives the drum stands on, its roof copper

crossing gables._about: the great arches' half-round gables (zakomary) on the four sides of the deck, their short barrel roofs running in to the drum

dome._about: the drum of twenty arched windows between colonnettes, the gilded dome over it (its top 45 m over the square), the ball and the cross (`drum-dome`)
